notes.title: 5,000 Wishlists and Counting! + Gamescom Reflections
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hello everyone,[/b][/p][p]We’ve recently passed an important milestone: [i]Voivod: The Nuclear Warrior[/i] has now been added to over [b]5,000 Steam wishlists[/b]! A huge thank you to all of you who’ve already shown your support. Every wishlist helps boost visibility on Steam, which in turn brings more eyes to the project. Please keep spreading the word: word-of-mouth makes a big difference for indie titles like ours.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45547030/5fa0e471718bdec7427ef0ec817bf4246aa1b5a4.png"][/img][/p][p]Last week we had the chance to showcase the game at [b]Gamescom 2025[/b], the world’s largest videogame fair. For the occasion we built a new prototype, polishing gameplay, mechanics, art, and sound to make sure the slice we showed was representative of where we’re headed. Seeing people play the game directly was incredibly valuable: it gave us feedback on what feels right, what can be improved, and what excites players the most. We’ve already started integrating those insights into development.[/p][p][/p][p]We also want to share a new piece of content with you: the [b]Title Screen[/b], featuring the very first moments when launching the game, complete with a new arrangement of [i]Holographic Thinking [/i]track by Voivod. This screen will set the tone for your journey every time you step into Voivod’s dark, dystopian multiverse. [/p][previewyoutube="EHi7LvUFmyY;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]If you can’t wait to play the game, we still have [b]late pledges available[/b] on our [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/piovesan/voivod-the-nuclear-warrior/"]Kickstarter campaign[/url]. One of the tiers even lets you join our development Discord server as a [b]beta tester[/b], giving you access to play the game before anyone else, share feedback directly with us, and help shape the final experience.[/p][p][/p][p]We’re very excited about the progress and can’t wait to share more in the months ahead. In the meantime, please continue to [b]wishlist the game on Steam[/b] if you haven’t already. And even more importantly, [b]share the Steam page with friends, communities, or anywhere you think people might enjoy the project[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for following along,
Nicola & the Chaosmonger Studio team[/p]

notes.title: Voivod Development Update - DevLog #01
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hi everyone![/b][/p][p]It’s been a couple of months since the end of our Kickstarter campaign, and development on [i]Voivod: The Nuclear Warrior[/i] has been moving full throttle.[/p][p]A lot has happened in a short time: we’ve expanded several areas, built new content, and revisited key sections to enhance atmosphere and immersion. One standout example is a major visual overhaul of an early-game zone. We've improved animations, added multi-layered parallax effects, and reworked the lighting to give the environment more depth and mood. Check out the before/after comparison video below to see the evolution.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="hzg4CbEuGGM;full"][/previewyoutube][p]We’ve also been refining the main character’s core animations—especially running and jumping—to make movement feel more fluid, grounded, and responsive. Below you’ll find a before/after GIF that highlights these improvements.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45547030/944abb6030438139d5965353073206207f3bfb7a.gif"][/img][/p][p]Meanwhile, we’re preparing a playable build for [b]Gamescom 2025[/b], where we’ll present the game to potential publishers and press. If you're attending the event in Cologne (August 19–24) and have access to the business area, feel free to drop by the Nordic Pavilion and say hello![/p][p]We’re excited about what’s ahead and can’t wait to share more soon. In the meantime, if you haven’t already, please consider [b]wishlisting the game on Steam[/b] and spreading the word—it really helps support the project and increases visibility.[/p][p]Stay tuned,
The Chaosmonger Studio team[/p]

notes.title: Metal platformer Voivod: The Nuclear Warrior from Chaosmonger now on Kickstarter and smashed the funding goal
notes.notes:
With a world inspired by the lore and iconic concept albums of the metal music band Voivod, the latest retro-inspired game from Chaosmonger Studio is live on Kickstarter.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/04/metal-platformer-voivod-the-nuclear-warrior-from-chaosmonger-now-on-kickstarter-and-smashed-the-funding-goal/

notes.title: Metal band Voivod are getting an official video game from Chaosmonger Studio
notes.notes:
Chaosmonger Studio developer of ENCODYA, Speedollama, Three Minutes To Eight and Clunky Hero have announced their working on an official video game for the metal band Voivod.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/03/metal-band-voivod-are-getting-an-official-video-game-from-chaosmonger-studio/
